text:
- **Site answers agent questions:** Agents' ask-tool questions now appear on the site, with options and free text. Claude and Codex both route their questions there. The first answer, on the site or in chat, wins.
- **Faster Go test runs:** A pull request now runs only the Go test packages its files can affect. Only tests that can differ by operating system run on macOS. Main still runs every test. Docs-only changes skip the Go checks. Go test compute fell sharply for changes outside the store, but pull request wall time missed its target.
- **Agent guidance and rules:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build all read in full. An agent grades it against a rubric on every pull request. The CI job signs in without a stored API key. Agents now open a project, sprint or task for owner-asked work without asking leave.
- **Code layout and sprint checks:** The code under internal/cli now splits by noun. Every function stays under the complexity limit. Obsolete Python-port code is deleted. A sprint close now checks only the patterns that sprint added or changed.
